entry.action: Project layout refactored into assets/components and assets/nav.
app.js component loader adjusted to target assets/components/header.html and assets/components/footer.html.
Search and translation generation automation scripts seeded: scripts/generate-search-index.js and scripts/generate-translation-catalog.js.
Legal HTML stubs normalized under assets/nav into valid HTML documents.
Footer legal links mapped to assets/nav.
Footer compliance text set to canonical GDPR string: "© 2026 BlueTEXT. All tools execute client-side. Zero tracker policy."
Sitemap generator updated to index assets/nav resources and filter non-page directories.
Unified data generators wrapper added under scripts/run-all-generators.js.
package.json scripts created for npm run build:data and granular generator flags.
Build report json created at assets/data/build-report.json mapping logs, status, and durations.
Upgraded Bootstrap bundle from 5.3.3 to 5.3.8 across all 98 HTML/JS source files.
Mapped new CSS and JS bundle integrity hashes (SRIs).
Updated dynamic index generator templates.
Search mechanism resolved to read search-index.json with link scraping fallbacks.
Unified all automation workflows directly into scripts/build.js script.
Enforced header-component and footer-component structural mounts globally.
Deduplicated layout templates and normalized index layout stubs.
Resolved conflicts in build.js directory walking to prevent static folders from being overwritten.
Integrated Google Font Inter globally through base.css and config.css styles.
Validated tag closures across 533 generated files.
Removed beta brand markings from header component.
Added mobile navbar icons (search and user accounts toggle buttons).
Wired mobile navbar search fields to trigger modal dialogs.
Synchronized mobile auth handles in auth.js.
Added high contrast variables complying with WCAG 2.1 AA benchmarks inside themes.css.
Optimized build-time translation pipelines by grouping dictionary strings in 50-item batches, saving 50x API overhead.
Pre-compiled lookup dictionary datasets for 20 major world languages inside assets/data/i18n/.
Enabled local dictionary loading in nav.js to bypass CORS preflight redirects.
Defaulted landing pages to load in Dark Mode and English language.
Refactored build.js to run concurrent promise pools (runPool) and file change validation checks (writeIfChanged).
Implemented double-pipe delimiter batching (" ||| ") for Google Translate requests.
Redesigned landing page index.html with a sleek hero header and card grid layouts.
Added build-time header and footer compilation (injectHeaderFooter in build.js) to resolve layout shifting.
Bypassed dynamic AJAX loading in app.js if static layouts are pre-populated in the DOM.
Fixed query encoding in Google Translate API query strings.
Added binary-split search fallbacks in translateBatchWithRetry to isolate mismatched segments.
Configured offline Simplifed to Traditional Chinese conversions using chinese-conv package.
Transformed documentation metadata (Agent, Architecture, Design, Memory) into structured XML files for machine and AI legibility.
Redesigned landing page index.html into a dynamic single-page dashboard inspired by VS Code portal hubs.
Implemented left column category sidebars (desktop) and horizontal scroll navigation pills (mobile).
Added live inline category filtering and search rendering on index.html, bypassing search modal popups for home page navigation.
Replaced the Clear Cache header icon button with a high-visibility red outline text button.
Overhauled themes.css to mirror VS Code dark (#1e1e1e) and light (#ffffff) palettes with high-contrast text and border compliance.
Expanded translation extraction in build.js and nav.js to query span, li, h4, h5, and h6 nodes, raising translatable dataset size to 1910 terms.
